name: Elk County, PA
findings: Elk County has 150 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Elk County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Elk County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Elk County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 8 education organizations here list public events, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
